arguments.sql:
WITH node_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM main.customer_nodes
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
transaction_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
node_only AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM node_customers
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id FROM transaction_customers
),
transaction_only AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM transaction_customers
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id FROM node_customers
)
SELECT txn_type,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count,
       MIN(txn_date) AS first_date,
       MAX(txn_date) AS last_date,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(customer_id) AS missing_customer_ids,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(txn_amount) AS missing_amounts,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negative_amounts,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(txn_date) IS NULL OR LENGTH(txn_date) <> 10 THEN 1 END) AS irregular_dates,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.customer_nodes) AS node_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM node_customers) AS node_customer_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM node_only) AS node_only_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_only) AS transaction_only_count
FROM main.customer_transactions
GROUP BY txn_type
ORDER BY txn_type
LIMIT 1000

arguments.sql:
WITH calendar(month) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01'), ('2020-02'), ('2020-03'), ('2020-04'),
           ('2020-05'), ('2020-06'), ('2020-07'), ('2020-08'),
           ('2020-09'), ('2020-10'), ('2020-11'), ('2020-12')
),
activity AS (
    SELECT SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS month,
           customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7), customer_id
),
population AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count
    FROM main.customer_transactions
)
SELECT c.month,
       p.customer_count,
       COUNT(a.customer_id) AS customers_with_any_transaction,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_customer_count,
       TOTAL(a.balance) AS total_balance,
       TOTAL(a.balance) / p.customer_count AS all_customer_average
FROM calendar AS c
CROSS JOIN population AS p
LEFT JOIN activity AS a ON a.month = c.month
GROUP BY c.month, p.customer_count
ORDER BY c.month
LIMIT 1000

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2020-12-01'
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM main.customer_nodes
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_flows AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           DATE(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           SUM(CASE txn_type
                   WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                   WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
               END) AS balance
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01'
      AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
      AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE(txn_date, 'start of month')
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT m.month_start,
           c.customer_id,
           COALESCE(f.balance, 0) AS balance
    FROM months AS m
    CROSS JOIN customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_flows AS f
      ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND f.month_start = m.month_start
),
monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT month_start,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_customer_count,
           AVG(balance) AS average_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month_start
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT MAX(positive_customer_count) AS highest_count,
           MIN(positive_customer_count) AS lowest_count
    FROM monthly_summary
)
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', hi.month_start) AS highest_count_month,
       STRFTIME('%Y-%m', lo.month_start) AS lowest_count_month,
       hi.average_balance AS highest_count_month_average_balance,
       lo.average_balance AS lowest_count_month_average_balance,
       hi.average_balance - lo.average_balance AS average_balance_difference
FROM extremes AS e
JOIN monthly_summary AS hi ON hi.positive_customer_count = e.highest_count
JOIN monthly_summary AS lo ON lo.positive_customer_count = e.lowest_count
ORDER BY hi.month_start, lo.month_start
LIMIT 1000
